title: Reproduction Art
slide_intent: Teach designers to select a prepared configuration at its intended size. A name broken into two lines occupies a different space from the same name in a narrow column.
strategic_value: NASA can protect both letterform proportions and the setting of its full name by issuing configurations that already fit common formats.
demonstration: Two columns repeat agency lockups at five descending sizes. The narrower version wraps the agency name across four lines, while the wider version uses two.
practical_value: Choose the width and printed specimen size that fit the space. The page directs users to reproduce these typographic masters at their shown sizes.

content_islands.name: Use instructions
content_islands.spec: Group the heading, same-size reproduction instruction and supply note at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Two-column size comparison
content_islands.spec: Align the narrow and wide agency lockups in rows of descending size, keeping the repeated names attached to their marks.
